issues.reason: The clause is a habitual-present characteristic claim, which is exactly what the bare-plural split reserves for the generic rule route, and an adjectivally-restricted kind subject "forces the distributing-rule route ... the restriction becomes a premise conjunct"; the group-witness route instead asserts a specific existing set of low moth-counts and one full-confidence keeping occurrence the text never individuates.

(Member sk_group_1 low) is the explicitly barred form - "a property of a plural's members is never predicated of the group symbol ... a descriptive modifier or copular predicate on a plural always goes through the distributive rule (or, for a bare plural, the kind)" - and "low" is a per-count property, not a property of the collection itself.

Real that no atom in the parse carries the empirical-generic confidence a characteristic claim requires, but overstated as an independent truth-value error: given the episodic framing the parser chose, (STV 1.0 0.99) is the correct TV for an asserted event, so the TV follows the form error rather than being a separate one.

gaps_confirmed: transitive maintenance/preventive verb with a locative result ("keep X out of Y"): the State-result + (Still ...) shape is specified for adjectival results only, and "out of" states a non-position for which the entity-attached position heads have no polarity carrier
defect_summary: Compliant form for both confirmed issues is one distributing rule - (Implication (And (Member $x moth_count) (Member $x low) (LocatedIn $x stilllight_lantern)) (And (Member (sk_keep $x) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $x) $x) (Theme (sk_keep $x) sky_cat) ...)) at (STV 0.9 0.9) - with the restrictive "low" riding a premise conjunct on $x instead of (Member <group> low), and no group witness or token event at all. Inside that conclusion the "out of the cove" result still has no licensed head, which is the confirmed gap above.
notes: Names/casing for "the Stilllight Lantern" (capitalized run exceeds the bare class word, so Name plus a separate kind atom), the compound genera and the "at" -> LocatedIn choice are all correct. The whole defect is subject-side quantificational form.
